column3: Close to the Hebrew; “pastures of grass” is rendered “green pastures,” and “waters of rest” “the still waters.”
Close to the Hebrew; צַלְמָוֶת (“deep darkness”) is rendered “the shadow of death.”
Close to the Hebrew; דִּשַּׁנְתָּ (“you have fattened”) is rendered “You anoint,” and “my cup is saturation” “My cup runs over.”
NKJV renders “covenant loyalty” as “mercy,” וְשַׁבְתִּי (“I will return”) as “I will dwell,” and “for length of days” as “Forever.”
